ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: How many things feed on krill?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, with light green ovals representing different organisms, and arrows connecting them. The oval labeled “Krill” is located at the lower left of the figure. It can be seen that the arrowheads of three arrows point to “Krill”: they come from “Seals”, “Squids”, and “Baleen Whales” respectively. There is another arrow from “Krill” to “Microplankton”, which does not belong to the arrows pointing to Krill. Reasoning: The question asks how many things feed on krill. According to the arrow rule in the figure, arrows go from the predator to the organism being eaten, so it is necessary to count the sources of the arrows pointing to Krill. The sources are Seals, Squids, and Baleen Whales, for a total of 3.
